name: WESTAR-35 blaster pistol
description: The WESTAR-35 blaster pistol was a model of blaster pistol from the WESTAR series of blasters. As a product of the WESTAR series of blasters, the WESTAR-35 was the successor to the WESTAR-20 and WESTAR-34 blaster pistols. The WESTAR-35 was also capable of firing yellow or blue bolts of plasma. It was the favored weapon of numerous Mandalorians.
